【Let's Talk About Session 9: 3/28】

Welcome to Let's Talk About

★Topic: Street Markets 

Street markets are vibrant places where culture, commerce, and community come together. From floating markets in Thailand to flea markets in Paris, these spots are rich with stories and flavors. Have you ever visited a street market that left a lasting impression? What makes them different from modern supermarkets? Let’s dive into the charm of street markets while practicing how to describe and discuss them in English.

Date: March 28 (Friday)
Time: 12:15 - 13:15
Held Online (Google Meet; the link will be sent after registration)
Host: Ariana

★本週主題：街市

街市是匯聚文化、商業與社群的熱鬧場所。從泰國的水上市場到巴黎的跳蚤市場，這些地方充滿著無數故事與風味。你曾否造訪過某個令人難以忘懷的街市呢？又是什麼讓它們與現代超市截然不同？讓我們一邊練習用英文描述和討論街市，一邊領略它們獨特的魅力。

日期：3/28 （五）
時間：12:15 - 13:15
連結：另行寄送
主持人：Ariana

快來加入我們，一起開口說英語！
